title.es: La primera semana del intercambio escolar
title.en: A First Week on the School Exchange

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A2 con un texto original sobre school exchange.
intro.en: Practise A2 English reading with an original text about school exchange.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: When I arrived in Leeds for the school exchange, I expected to feel lonely. Instead, my host family invited me to a neighbourhood football match on the first evening. At school, my partner, Josh, showed me the library and explained the timetable. I understood most lessons, although I needed extra time with the science vocabulary. On Wednesday, our class visited a local theatre. I missed my parents that night, but I wrote them a message and felt better. To remember new words, I started a small notebook and reviewed five of them each night before sleeping. Josh laughed at my pronunciation at first, but he soon began correcting me gently instead. By Friday, I could order lunch, ask for directions, and join conversations without translating every sentence in my head.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: When I arrived in Leeds for the school exchange, I expected to feel lonely. Instead, my host family invited me to a neighbourhood football match on the first evening. At school, my partner, Josh, showed me the library and explained the timetable. I understood most lessons, although I needed extra time with the science vocabulary. On Wednesday, our class visited a local theatre. I missed my parents that night, but I wrote them a message and felt better. To remember new words, I started a small notebook and reviewed five of them each night before sleeping. Josh laughed at my pronunciation at first, but he soon began correcting me gently instead. By Friday, I could order lunch, ask for directions, and join conversations without translating every sentence in my head.
